digest.component_or_area: bridge run orchestration and provider wrappers
propositions: Bridge orchestration must be extracted into a runner-neutral packaged Python core and exposed through three public surfaces: Python library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run), and MCP (bridge_run tool).

All five provider MODE values (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) must remain accepted for backward compatibility while the new public operation uses canonical noun profile.
The wheel must ship from and prove availability through all supported install paths: pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, and MCP Registry/uvx.

Provider wrappers (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) must invoke the installed CLI entrypoint (rebar bridge run) rather than repository-local scripts, with schema validation and embedded shell linting.
Legacy direct reconcile callers must retain benign results 3/4/75; the runner translates these to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2.
Strict ticket-store delivery on successful non-paused runs requires run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; delivery failure returns 1 with diagnostics.
